下列「」內的字音，何者正確？
(A)「涮」涮鍋：ㄕㄨㄚ             (B)「呱」呱墜地：ㄍㄨ
(C)「鰻」魚飯：ㄇㄢˋ             (D)通「緝」：ㄐㄧˊ

下列詞語，何者可以表達父母對於子女的關愛？
(A)烏鳥私情   (B)百身何贖  (C)愛屋及烏             (D)寸草春暉

在各種婚喪喜慶的場合中，常見友人贈送題辭致意。如要慶祝好友的飯店開張，下列何者是 最合適的祝賀詞？
(A)貨殖留芳  (B)業紹陶朱   (C)洙泗高風  (D)忠勤足式

下列「」中的詞語，何者為狀聲詞？
(A)「潺潺」小溪蜿蜒的穿越森林         (B)景仰如「滔滔」江水綿延不絕
(C)「漫漫」長夜他只能獨自承受著孤寂      (D)「涓涓」細流也能匯成大江河

在詩文中，常見作者以動物或植物作為比喻。下列「」內的詞語，何者象徵小人？
(A)「雞」鳴不已於風雨       (B)「松柏」後凋於歲寒
(C)牛驥同一皁，「雞」棲鳳凰食   (D)荷盡已無擎雨蓋，「菊」殘猶有傲霜枝

下列選項中，何者屬於摹寫修辭？
(A)雨，看像牛毛、像花針、像細絲、密密地斜織著
(B)聽一遍不如看一遍，看一遍不如做一遍
(C)涼沁沁的微風撲撲地貼拂著我的臉頰
(D)那池畔的金柳像是夕陽的新娘 共同科目(國文、英文) 第 1 頁，共 4 頁          【請翻頁繼續作答】

下列文句均出自古典小說或戲曲故事，其出處搭配，何者有誤？
(A)有情人終成眷屬：《西廂記》   (B)賠了夫人又折兵：《水滸傳》
(C)劉姥姥進大觀園：《紅樓夢》   (D)過五關，斬六將：《三國演義》

下列成語中，何者用來說明父母去世？
(A)風木之思   (B)西河之痛                                (C)雁行失序             (D)鼓盆之戚

下列古文名篇內容之敘述，何者有誤？
(A)蘇洵＜六國論＞藉論六國賂秦之弊，諷諭宋朝屈辱求和的政策
(B)蘇軾＜前赤壁賦＞藉變與不變之辯證，表現作者通達的人生觀
(C)韓愈＜師說＞藉贈文李戡的機會，批判時人一味崇尚佛老的風氣
(D)顧炎武＜廉恥＞藉論「士大夫之無恥，是謂國恥」，寄寓作者對易代之際，士人變節的感慨

下列4個選項，何者意義與其他3個不同？
(A)知之者不如好之者，好之者不如樂之者
(B)苗而不秀者，有矣夫！秀而不實者，有矣夫
(C)有為者，辟若掘井，掘井九軔而不及泉，猶為棄井也
(D)山徑之蹊間，介然用之而成路，為間不用，則茅塞之矣

如要寫一篇「戰國四公子」的研究報告，下列書籍中何者最無參考價值？
(A)《史記》   (B)《國語》  (C)《戰國策》  (D)《資治通鑑》

下列各組「」中的字義，何者相同？
(A)莫「逆」之交/「逆」情干譽                                (B)「易」容改扮/「易」如反掌
(C)擢髮難「數」/「數」見不鮮                                (D)不「虞」匱乏/爾「虞」我詐

下列關於《裨海紀遊》的說明，何者有誤？
(A)「裨海」代指臺灣         (B)作者為郁永河
(C)是首部有系統描述臺灣的遊記專著  (D)作者以第三人稱客觀的角度敘述所見所聞

「黃□一夢」比喻榮華富貴不持久，為時短暫而虛空。□內宜填入下列何者？
(A)梁      (B)樑     (C)粱      (D)糧 貳、英文：100 % 【單選題： 40 題，每題 2.5 分，共 100 分；請在『答案卡』題號 16~55 畫記作答。】

Employers are required to treat male and female workers equally because _____ equality is a government policy in Taiwan.
(A) grinder            (B) gender          (C) agenda           (D) tender

The sun and wind are two major sources of _____ energy that many countries around the world have been trying to develop.
(A) recycling           (B) reusable         (C) renewable         (D) returnable

Nowadays, a lot of people waste so much time _____ the Internet.
(A) surfing            (B) playing            (C) traveling         (D) sailing

Paul didn’t go to university, so he only has a high school _____.
(A) paper               (B) document              (C) grade         (D) diploma

Keelung is the _____ city in Taiwan.
(A) northernmost       (B) north                (C) mostly north    (D) northest 共同科目(國文、英文) 第 2 頁，共 4 頁

Surprisingly, Sam passed the exam _____ that he had not prepared at all.
(A) thought            (B) despite            (C) even                 (D) but

Taipei 101 is the most famous _____ in the city and attracts many tourists from in and outside the country each year.
(A) landmark           (B) benchmark         (C) indicator          (D) street sign

Most children _____ their parents and talk like them.
(A) love               (B) follow                (C) imitate              (D) hear

On the way back from the US, we only had a 2-hour _____ in Tokyo and couldn’t leave the airport to visit the city.
(A) transport         (B) translation        (C) transform         (D) transit

Smoking on the MRT is _____ forbidden and the fine is not a small amount.
(A) usually          (B) probably           (C) absolutely          (D) exactly

Harry really liked the new Mazda, but the price was over his _____.
(A) money                (B) target             (C) pocket                (D) budget

At present, the official _____ age is 65 in government agencies in Taiwan.
(A) retire                (B) retired            (C) retirement        (D) to retire

Steve takes his daughters to _____ kites in the park every Sunday if it is a sunny day.
(A) blow                (B) release              (C) set                  (D) fly

Generally, it is considered impolite _____ when other people are talking.
(A) to interrupt         (B) to cut            (C) to break             (D) to miss

Our company often holds _____ because we have employees working in different parts of the country.
(A) conferences       (B) audio conferences (C) videoconferences (D) videos

If you want to get a job with Taiwan Power Company, you need to _____ a test.
(A) participate          (B) join             (C) take              (D) prepare

Children have to attend elementary school _____ six years in Taiwan.
(A) by                  (B) in                (C) over               (D) for

Today, a lot of people use “plastic money” to buy things; in other words, they pay _____ credit cards.
(A) to                  (B) in                  (C) with                (D) for

Jessie is taking the afternoon _____ to see her mother in the hospital.
(A) off                   (B) out                (C) away                 (D) in

Willy has no idea where his sister Judy is. He hasn’t heard _____ her for months.
(A) about              (B) from                  (C) for                (D) to

The research team needs to hurry up because the project is _____ schedule.
(A) late              (B) falling             (C) after               (D) behind

It normally _____ about 20 minutes to go to work by car.
(A) spends me          (B) takes me           (C) costs me                (D) wastes me

December is the last month of a year. It _____ November.
(A) goes after         (B) comes after          (C) is past               (D) next to

“I need _____. Can you take this document to the accounting office for me?”
(A) hand              (B) a hand               (C) hands               (D) some hand

Joyce looked like she _____ cry when the manager told her she was not good enough for her job.
(A) was to              (B) had to           (C) was about to        (D) knew how to

Alex, my college classmate, works in the same neighborhood, so I often _____ him on the MRT.
(A) walk into          (B) run into           (C) come into           (D) go into 共同科目(國文、英文) 第 3 頁，共 4 頁                                        【請翻頁繼續作答】

Jobs in public enterprises are more stable; _____, more and more young people choose to work in such companies when they finish college education.
(A) as a result          (B) as an excuse        (C) as usual          (D) as indicated

The police _____ the bar last week because it was too noisy.
(A) closed down        (B) closed up           (C) shut up              (D) stopped

The marathon will be held this Saturday, _____. It cannot be postponed.
(A) sun or rain        (B) dry or wet          (C) rain or shine       (D) raining or shining

Peter usually takes his time to eat because he really _____ a nice meal.
(A) enjoys to have        (B) enjoys having      (C) likes to            (D) has to

I lived next door to ______ when I was a kid. I know every one of them.
(A) Johnson families (B) the Johnson’s          (C) Johnson family    (D) the Johnsons

Ken seems unable to keep a job. He _____ in six different companies in the past two years.
(A) has worked        (B) works               (C) had worked          (D) is working

I’m going to say goodbye to Frank. He _____ to Kaohsiung next week.
(A) will be moved      (B) is moving          (C) just moved        (D) has moved

At work, Tom is responsible _____ the company’s website.
(A) for maintaining   (B) to maintain       (C) in maintenance          (D) with maintaining

LA Lakers _____ last night, but they made too many errors in the game.
(A) should have won (B) should win            (C) should won         (D) should have been won

Taichung is _____ of Taipei and Keelung is north of Taipei.
(A) in the south       (B) to the south        (C) the south            (D) on the south

I would lend you the money if I _____, but I really don’t.
(A) have it            (B) had it               (C) would have it       (D) should have it

The Thai restaurant across the street _____ in business for twenty years.
(A) has been            (B) is                  (C) was                  (D) will be

Ann has the habit of _____ once every two weeks.
(A) go to movie                              (B) see movie
(C) seeing the movie                         (D) going to the movies

Jill almost got hit by a motorcycle because she _____ with her cell phone when crossing the street.
(A) played                (B) was played        (C) was playing         (D) had been playing 共同科目(國文、英文) 第 4 頁，共 4 頁
